issues: The required-columns check uses `and` instead of `or`, so it only raises when all three columns are missing; it should raise if any required column is absent.
Checks for a 'group' column which isn't mentioned in the problem spec.
`asfreq(freq)` will introduce NaNs if the data doesn't align, which breaks `seasonal_decompose`; the frequency handling is fragile.

`decomposition.plot()` creates its own figure; the preceding `fig, ax = plt.subplots()` creates an unused extra figure, and `plt.gca()` returns an axes from the decomposition's new figure which may not be the intended Axes object.
Catching all exceptions and re-raising as ValueError is overly broad and can mask unrelated errors.
`freq` validity isn't actually verified beyond being a string; an invalid frequency string isn't caught upfront.
